c-member-link-preview.1.evidence: Composer paste-to-card flow not run in the browser; REST preview of https://wordpress.org/news/ works (see .2).

c-member-link-preview.2.evidence: bob GET /link-preview?url=https://wordpress.org/news/ -> 200 with title 'WordPress News', description, image fields, site_name/domain, favicon, type, provider.

c-member-link-preview.4.evidence: Needs a published topic with a card.

c-member-link-preview.5.evidence: http://localhost/, http://127.0.0.1/, http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/, http://10.0.0.1/ and a non-URL all return 200 with empty title, description, image and site_name; file:///etc/passwd returns an empty url too.

c-member-link-preview.6.evidence: Hostname resolving to a private address and a redirect to 127.0.0.1 not set up.

c-member-link-preview.9.evidence: Second request for the same good URL returns the same data in 31 ms (served from cache).

c-member-link-preview.10.evidence: Redirect-loop and 6-hop targets not set up.

c-member-link-preview.11.evidence: Guest GET /link-preview for http://127.0.0.1/ -> 200 with an empty preview (blocked-URL answer), no fetch of the private host.

c-member-link-preview.16.evidence: Guest GET /link-preview?url=https://wordpress.org/news/ -> 200 with the full fetched preview (title, description). Expected 401 or a rate-limited answer; the endpoint is an open server-side fetch for logged-out visitors (the check line itself notes this).

c-member-link-preview.17.evidence: Standalone wordpress.org post link card not rendered in a published topic.
